title: Harvey Platform Overview
format_note: Narrated 3:52 tour of Assistant, Word and Outlook add-ins, Vault, review tables and Workflows, built from real product capture with text-only chapter cards.
one_thing: A calm narrated tour where every spoken claim is paired with a captured screen or a big serif number, so the product explains itself without hype.

transcript.voice_style: Even, measured narrator reading full sentences; no on-camera presenter; claims stated as plain numbers and product nouns.
transcript.script_shape: Proof stats (0-28s), then one chapter per product area: Assistant, Microsoft suite, Vault, review tables, workflows, customer stats, tagline.

structure.frame0: Centered black serif 'Harvey' wordmark on near-white; contentfulCells 0.031, so almost empty. No product in frame.
structure.first_3s: Wordmark holds to 2.0s, then a hard cut to a grey world map with countries shading dark while the narrator gives 74,000 lawyers, 58 countries.

beats.what: Wordmark, then world map with shaded countries under 'over 74,000 lawyers at 700 organizations in 58 countries'.
'Accelerate Expertise' card, a grid of workflow tiles, then 24 counting to '25 Hours Saved'.
Floating UI fragments around an H, desktop plus phone mockup, then four compliance badges: SOC2 II, CCPA, ISO 27001, GDPR.
One 77.8s Assistant capture: sources menu, country list, prompt typing, Improve, agent flowchart, answer, email draft, editor with versions.
Harvey / Microsoft lockup and Word, Outlook, SharePoint card, then Word edits and NDA playbook, then Outlook summary.
Dark Vault card, 'Matters Documents Research', Vault grid, Commercial Contracts folder growing to 100,000 files.
Review table: file picker, column builder, filled table, then '96% Accuracy vs. 89% Contract Attorneys'.
Export buttons, 'Workflows' card, workflow gallery, prompt text highlighted then turned into a node graph.
'651 Deployments' on black, then four customer stats (7 Hours, 60%, 96%, 50%).
'AI Tailored for Law' with Harvey wordmark below on pale grey.

hero_moment.what: Blurred review table behind '96% Accuracy vs. 89% Contract Attorneys', the film's one head-to-head number (f0095 sheet 6, t=3:10).

ending.what: Static tagline over the Harvey wordmark on pale grey, identical in f0115 and f0116; no URL or button.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: Short card shots in the first 30s (cuts at 2, 7.2, 9.7, 23, 30.4), then three long captures: 77.8s (33.6% of runtime), 23.3s and 10.5s. Inside them UI state changes about every 1.7s (median hold). No burst.

look.ground: Near-white (frame luma 239), with pale grey-green and off-white panels; two near-black cards (t=142, t=218). Light share 0.983.
palette: Microsoft blue only in app chrome
look.accent_use: No brand accent colour: saturation 0.008, bw_share 0.67. Colour appears only inside real UI (red redlines, green/amber status dots, partner logos).
look.type: Large high-contrast serif for headlines and numbers; small grotesque sans for UI, subtext and card labels. Centred, single line, no weight changes.
look.depth: Flat. UI panels have hairline borders and no real shadow; depth comes from scale changes and a faint cube pattern at t=26-28.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Crops are punched in to the active region (f0049, f0097, f0100), then the view pulls out to the full app; Word and Outlook panels are shown full width first, then magnified.
product_ui.notes: Prompt text, buttons and cards read well at 1280 px (crops prompt-ui.png, draft-card.png). Wide shots of the Outlook window, the table (f0082) and the Vault grid have 8-10 px text and would fail on a phone.

motion.text_entry: Chapter cards appear whole after a hard cut (strip window-04); prompts type character by character with a cursor (f0043, f0079). 'Matters' enters alone and 'Documents' and 'Research' follow.
motion.ui_motion: Scripted interactions: menus open, a PDF chip drops into the prompt, checkboxes tick, columns generate, a progress bar fills, version labels switch 1 to 2. Flowchart nodes light up in sequence (f0037).
motion.camera: Slow zooms and pans on the map and on captured screens; the browser window scales down to reveal a phone mockup at 20.9s (strip window-12).
motion.eases: Not measurable from sampled frames; strips show motion settling softly on tiles and on the mockup scale, with no overshoot visible.

transitions.cause: Narration moves to the next claim; the cut lands on the new subject, as at 2.0s into the map.
A click or typed prompt changes the same capture: menu opens, chip drops, answer streams in.
Dark Vault card brightens to white over about 0.5s before the Vault interface (strip window-57).
H logo cuts to a browser window that scales down to make room for a phone mockup.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: Card holds (2.0-6 s) clear the 0.5 s plus 0.3 s a word rule; the 2x2 stat grid at 4 s is tightest. The last line holds 5.5 s against the 2 s floor.

sound.music: A bed under narration. describe tags: music 0.628, keyboard_musical 0.328, synthesizer 0.285, percussion 0.213; piano 0.135 is below the 0.2 threshold. No steady beat (confidence 0.028).
sound.sfx: None identified; no sound-effect tag scores above 0.2 (water 0.156, whale_vocalization 0.147).
sound.vo_music_balance: Speech scores 0.82, music 0.628: narration leads and the bed sits under it; no gap in the speech except the last 1.6 s of silence from 230 s.
sound.energy_arc: Flat: loudness range 2.9 LU, short-term max -10.6 LUFS against -14.1 integrated, 19 music sections A-S with no obvious climax.
sound.sync_to_picture: Not locked: cuts_on_strong_onset_share 0.091 against chance_share 0.06, a 0.031 gap, under the 0.10 bar. Cuts follow the narration instead.

good.observation: Each narrated claim gets a matching image within a second or two: 58 countries as a shaded map, security as four badges, 100,000 files as a folder count rolling up.
The prompt, the 'Improve' click, the answer, the follow-up and the editable draft run as one continuous capture with a real cursor, so the viewer sees how it is used.
Big serif numbers on a blank ground make the proof beats easy to take in: titles run 5.4-8.3% of frame height with at most 4 words a line.
Text-only chapter cards (Harvey / Microsoft, Word Outlook SharePoint, Matters Documents Research, Workflows) tell the viewer what area is next before any dense UI arrives.
The workflow prompt text is highlighted phrase by phrase, then the same phrases appear as nodes in a flowchart, so the viewer sees the description become the structure.
Palette discipline: off-white, grey-green and near-black only, with colour left to the product's own interface.
The ending holds the tagline and wordmark for about 5.5 s with nothing else moving.

weak.observation: Frame 0 is a lone wordmark on empty ground for 2 s, so the product and the claim arrive only after the first cut.
The 77.8 s capture carries long dead stretches, such as a 14 s static run and the scrolling country list, while the narrator moves to the next sentence.
Wide shots of Outlook, the Vault grid and the review table use 8-10 px text, so the proof is unreadable at phone width.
True peak is -0.2 dBTP, above the -1 dBTP ceiling, and the audio has no steady beat, so picture and sound are not locked.

rule_candidates.rule: A feature-explainer may let one captured UI take run 60 s or more if the on-screen state changes at least every 2 s and a cursor leads the eye.
rule_candidates.evidence: Longest shot 77.8 s (33.6% of runtime); median hold 1.73 s; real cursor in f0043 and f0079.

rule_candidates.rule: Open a product chapter with a text-only card of 1-3 words held 2-4 s, naming the area before showing its interface.
rule_candidates.evidence: Cards at 8.0, 102, 106, 150, 200 s: 'Accelerate Expertise', 'Harvey / Microsoft', 'Matters Documents Research', 'Workflows'.

rule_candidates.rule: Show customer proof as a 2x2 grid: logo, serif number at about 7% of frame height, and one or two lines of subtext, on alternating white and grey tiles.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0112 at t=222: four tiles, number measured 48 px of 720 (6.7%).

rule_candidates.rule: Headline lines of 1-4 words at 5-8% of frame height read cleanly on a sparse ground; this film measured 5.4-8.3% across six lines.
Hold the closing tagline and wordmark for 5 s or more with no other motion.
rule_candidates.evidence: 'AI Tailored for Law' static in f0115 and f0116, about 5.5 s from t=226 to the end.

rule_candidates.rule: Turn a typed description into structure on screen: highlight its key phrases in turn, then show the same phrases as boxes in a diagram.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0106 (highlighted phrases) to f0109 (File upload, Selection, Condition, Prompt nodes).

rule_candidates.rule: An explainer built on narration needs no cut burst; cuts follow the sentence, at 2.85 cuts a minute, and bursts stay empty.
Frame 0 may be a wordmark only if the first cut by 2.0 s lands on the proof subject; this film cuts to a data map at 2.0 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0001 wordmark; strip window-01-1.933s.jpg shows the cut to the map.
